component: MO2Headless (transactional GUI-free Mod Organizer 2 instance controller)
purpose: Fix the one 0.2.0 regression failure: `run` re-enabled a previously active plugin whose mod had been disabled BEFORE the run when the child left its row in plugins.txt; 0.2.1 restores markers only for plugins still in the effective tree and reports the rest as `missing` (#105 follow-up, hardening package 1 of 2026-09-01).

build.method: GitHub Actions build.yml (ModOrganizer2/build-with-mob-action) - this workstation has no Qt SDK

artifact.guiNote: ModOrganizer.exe from this artifact is pinned in toolchain.json but NOT copied into the instance; the instance GUI is still the 3769ece build, as for 0.2.0

behavior.runPreservesPlugins: as 0.2.0, plus: after the child exits, only plugins whose mod is still enabled in the effective tree get their activation marker restored; a previously active plugin whose mod was disabled before the run is reported in stateDelta.missing instead of being re-enabled
